_comment: Hand-adjudicated matches for scanned rows the tiered matcher cannot resolve: names garbled past its edit-distance bound, constituency names misread into another region's look-alike, names printed in Latin script, and one printed name shared by two candidates. Keys are the exact printed strings from the sheet, whitespace-normalized, so an entry can only ever catch the one row it was written for. 'votes' narrows a key to a single vote row where a printed name is not unique. The matched candidate record supplies the name, party, constituency and region, which also refiles rows whose constituency was misread. Each note records the evidence for the match.
